hints.title: Thirty-two positions
hints.body: Process exactly 32 bits, even if the value is small.

hints.title: Read one bit
hints.body: The lowest bit of the input becomes the next bit of the result.

hints.title: Shift both sides
hints.body: Shift the result left and the input right after each step.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = 0
for step from 1 to 32:
    result = result * 2 + (value % 2)
    value = value // 2
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
